summary: Round w17 rates head 7744d1c (polishA: darker violet-grey jShell/jCap/jShellIn in 09_seats.js; jBand on the smooth plastic layer at #5d5e66). BEFORE = scratchpad r0, AFTER = r1, same cameras, boarding mood. (1) Shells: helped. q06 near shell side (0-120 x 380-560) (87,98,109) L96 h211 s0.20 -> (66,72,81) L71 h216 s0.19; far shell side (668-678) L65 -> L50 h235; cap tops (690-850 x 340-350) L128 -> L105 h233 s0.09. c_27312 shells: near side (10-90 x 420-500) L83 h214 s0.20, shell by the monitor (200-260 x 240-330) L50 h243 s0.17. c_27315 inner wall (470-520 x 240-300) L80 h225 s0.16, console face L76 h235 s0.20. c_27314 shell wing L98 h212 s0.20. So the official shells are cool blue-violet grey at s0.16-0.20, and the AFTER values sit inside that range in both tone and hue; BEFORE was 15-30 L too light. Ash/shell luma in q06 is now 129/50-71 = 1.8-2.6 (photos 2.2-3.0, before 1.3-1.6). The integration request for s <= 0.08 is contradicted by every official frame; its in-flight evidence (omaat r31 shell post h50 s0.16, kn_room_1) is warm cabin light / white balance, not albedo. The official-photo call is correct; I endorse the polishA value and would NOT neutralise further. Only caveat: in q09 the shells now read L47-62 against c_27314's L88-98, but c_27314 is a flash-lit top-down frame and the flap/shell ratio (model 1.5-2.0, c_27315 1.06-1.5, c_27312 1.4-2.3) is inside the photo spread; a lighting note, not a material issue. (2) Header band: the smooth plastic layer helped (the hammered-metal dimples in z_q10_band.png BEFORE are gone; AFTER hp 0.046-0.062 reads as satin, like c_27315 band hp 0.083-0.096 which includes the panel edges). The colour change hurt slightly: q08 band (480-560 x 290-330) (101,108,122) L108 h220 s0.17 -> (93,94,108) L95 h234 s0.14; q10 band L124 h217 -> L107 h231. In the photos the band matches the slate flap in hue and nearly in tone: c_27315 band L105-127 h218-221 s0.16 vs flap L119 h219 s0.19; c_27312 header L113 h218 s0.21; omaat_room_15 band/flap 0.89, omaat_room_31 1.05. Model band/flap q08: 0.82 before, 0.72 after, and the band now reads a separate mauve-grey part next to the blue-grey flap (z_q08.png). Net change for the band: smoother (+), colour (-), roughly neutral overall. Everything else is unchanged from w16 (no room geometry touched): same nested-pair layout, monuments, ash, soft goods. Prior w16 lows remain open. With the shells now closer to the official photos and only one low colour slip introduced, I keep the area at 8.5.
